sites.name: Star Tech
sites.note: Largest BD computer retailer; covers every current Mac line incl. Neo, M6 mini, M5 Max Studio. Sells imported units with '1 Year international warranty' (claims ~40 days), so marked unofficial. Prices shown are cash-discount prices; struck price used as oldPrice. Variant prices read by selecting options on the page. Mac mini M6 / Mac Studio pages carry an '(Inactive)' label in the title but show price and In Stock.

sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller with official Bangladesh warranty; one page per config; many Pro/iMac configs currently Stock Out.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Apple-focused importer (unofficial); per-variant prices with Regular vs CN region options (Regular used); often cheapest; many higher configs pre-order only.

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Unofficial importer ('1 Year Apple International Warranty'); good on Air/Neo/iMac; shows inflated strike-through prices; most Pro/Max configs are booking-only without a price.

sites.name: Executive Machines
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller & service provider (official); widest official config coverage incl. M5 Max and Mac Studio; usually highest prices.
